title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Settlement Standard: Store Refunds Credited to the Card
content:
**Standard.** The refund of a Marlowe & Finch return whose purchase was charged to a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account is credited to that same card account, never to another card, a gift card or cash, whatever the account's status (active, restricted, closed or charged-off). The same applies to a refund for an order cancelled before shipment and to a price adjustment.

**What the credit carries.** The credit names the reference of the refund or price adjustment record it settles, the purchase record and (for a return) the return record, and points to the original card purchase of that order by its transaction reference.

**Amount and timing.** The credit equals the amount that record settles to the card, which can never exceed the amount actually charged for the merchandise (after any welcome discount). It posts within 3 business days of the refund or adjustment.

**One credit per record.** No card credit has already posted for the same refund or price adjustment record, as the account's transaction records show.

**Effects on balances.** A credit for a special financing purchase reduces that promotional balance first. A credit that leaves the account with a credit balance is handled under the credit balance refund terms.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Situation | Credited to | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| a USD 120.00 return of a purchase charged to a closed Store Card | that closed Store Card account | USD 120.00, within 3 business days |
| a return of an item charged at USD 80.00 after a USD 20.00 welcome discount | the card charged | no more than USD 80.00 |
| a price adjustment of USD 15.00 on a card purchase | the card charged | USD 15.00 |
| a refund record that already has its card credit | — | no second credit |
| a refund on a promotional purchase | the card charged | reduces the promotional balance first |
